STRATEGY: Parent is a conditional-cooperation strategy: cooperate first 5 rounds, defect at n>=98, defect on 3+ consecutive opponent defections, defect if overall/recent opponent cooperation <0.3, otherwise forgive a single defection when cooperation is high. Simulated against AllD, single-defection-then-cooperate, and alternating D/C opponents. Changed by adding a hard rule to defect after 3 consecutive opponent defections, limiting forgiveness to 2 rounds.
